speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you've recently had antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis and are now experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever. To understand what is happening, please tell me: when did these new symptoms start relative to your sinusitis treatment?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your symptoms persisted even after your sinusitis improved, did you notice any changes in your urine color, volume, or the presence of blood? Also, have you experienced chills, nausea, or pain when urinating?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The rash appearing with amoxicillin suggests a possible hypersensitivity, but the new flank pain and fever point elsewhere. Did you experience any burning sensation while urinating or notice cloudiness in your urine?
